headline: Flydubai approved to resume flights to Tel Aviv after two months following thwarted attack
label: NEWS
caption:
Dubai carrier Flydubai gets the green light to fly to Tel Aviv again after a security review ✈️

According to reports from The National and The Times of Israel, Israeli authorities have given Flydubai approval to resume flights to Tel Aviv.

This decision comes two months after a thwarted attack prompted security concerns in the region.

Flydubai is now set to restore its flight routes to the Israeli city following the clearance.
